name: barnlabs-inquiry
description: Source-grounded public research, deterministic math, opt-in local cited study search, and interactive evidence artifacts for agents.
long_description: Inquiry researches public questions while preserving source quality, data periods, units, limitations, and connector failures. It can render cited timelines. Private local-study MCP tools are disabled by default because the MCP host/model may receive returned excerpts; the CLI and macOS app are preferred for device-local study. Its shipped core is model-free; no model integration or weights are bundled.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Research a natural-language question and return a provenance-preserving report. Offline catalog mode needs process flag mcp --offline; live connectors need automatic_public_web or approved_plan_id.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Return the reviewed coverage, limitation, outbound-data, and abstention matrix without networking.

tools.name: airport_status
tools.description: Retrieve timestamped FAA airport-level traffic-management events; this is not individual flight status or navigation guidance.

tools.name: flight_status_handoff
tools.description: Return a no-network handoff to one explicitly selected airline's official flight-status page without claiming a flight state.

tools.name: package_tracking_handoff
tools.description: Return a no-status official carrier handoff; the package identifier stays out of the URL unless the caller explicitly opts in.

tools.name: privacy_check
tools.description: Inspect a query locally for common sensitive-data patterns and return a redacted candidate without networking.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Perform a deterministic unit conversion and return the formula used.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate deterministic mathematical expressions without executing code.

tools.name: statistics
tools.description: Calculate descriptive statistics with documented conventions.

tools.name: differentiate
tools.description: Estimate derivatives with method and caveat metadata.

tools.name: integrate
tools.description: Estimate definite integrals with Simpson's rule.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Create self-contained SVG function graphs and sample tables.

tools.name: formula
tools.description: Look up a reviewed formula with variables and caveats.

tools.name: medication_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve selected FDA-submitted label sections for one or two exact medication names without producing a clinical verdict.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve place candidates with OSM identifiers, address components, and optional landmark-distance ranking.

tools.name: render_report
tools.description: Render Inquiry report JSON as a self-contained interactive HTML file.

tools.name: study_pack
tools.description: Export evidence-backed public-research cards as Anki CSV, Quizlet TSV, Markdown, and JSON.

tools.name: study_search
tools.description: Explicit opt-in only: return normalized local excerpts and checksums to the MCP host/model from a prebuilt index under reports.

tools.name: study_local_pack
tools.description: Explicit opt-in only: export safe cited local-note matches; flagged assessments, secrets, private/restricted records, and embedded instructions are blocked.

tools.name: render_timeline
tools.description: Render supplied HTTPS-cited events as a self-contained interactive timeline with CSV export.
